title: Optimization preservation
requirement: WHEN an optimization replaces a reference operation or representation, its proposal SHALL state a preservation predicate over all declared observations and costs.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Frame or sharing optimization
scenarios.when: A candidate reduces frame storage or interns equal nodes.
scenarios.then: Its record covers values, rejection/exhaustion, evaluation/effect order, boundaries, duties and resource schedule, with evidence and unresolved gaps separately listed.
scenarios.judgment: Evaluator reading (UIREQ-024 + optimization lane 10 + security-candidate-b logical allocation counters + D23/D30/D35): the record must state the predicate over exactly the six planes and the lane-10 cost planes, with evidence and unresolved gaps disjoint and every evidence claim verified (receipts cross-checked against runs.jsonl, the trace and git). Because the record's words are not evidence, the candidate must also be selectable on mori simulate and is replayed on sealed specimens: identical values, work/events/outcome, duties, reference stream, exhaustion and rejection; logical allocation counters may not drop; at least one equal-subtree specimen must show the physical reduction (non-vacuous).
unasserted: the physical metric names and amounts (only a strict reduction on some metric is required)
circuit/proof/DUST costs (must be gaps or evidence, not values)
the predicate checker's internal logic beyond the receipted tests
